body_lead: Bhubaneswar: Former Union minister Srikant Jena has written to Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi, seeking clarity on the proposed Adani AI data centre at Naraj, on the outskirts of Kataka. Jena pointed out that following the CMâs UAE visit, the Odisha government approved 27 projects worth Rs 2.47 lakh crore at the HLCA meeting on September 23, including the Adani-linked High Density Data Centre project at Naraj, with a proposed investment of Rs 1.04 lakh crore, a reported 1 GW (1000 MW) capacity and approximately 250 acres of land.
